thread:
tom: Flying into EDI 00:45, about 7h until my morning train. Any tips for a low-effort place to nap and charge without booking a whole hotel?
anya: Gate 6 benches are quiet late if you don't mind armrests. Bring a scarf as a blanket and an eye mask.
li: If you have Priority Pass, Aspire lounge is chill and has sockets + tea. Otherwise find a corner by a wall and tuck your bag under it.
edinburghbot: Heads-up: left luggage at EDI sometimes closes overnight. See https://www.edinburghairport.com/services/left-luggage for hours.
tom: Food recs for late-night that won't ruin a nap? Need something small and non-greasy.
anya: Scotch egg + an apple. Or a plain sandwich and electrolyte sachet. Avoid anything too spicy.
li: Instant oats + hot water at a cafe can be surprisingly calming. Also keep snacks in zip bags for smell control.
tom: Chargers: USB-C only these days or is mixed still a thing?
li: Mixed. Bring a short USB-C cable and a USB-A one just in case. Small 20k mAh battery is perfect (under 100Wh).
anya: Sleep setup: earplugs, thin hoodie, two alarms (phone + watch). Keep passport in your jacket pocket not in checked bag if you nod off.
tom: Any experience with hour-based hotel rooms by the tram? Worth it for 3-4h catch-up sleep?
li: If you can prebook and don't want to risk noisy cleaning rounds, yes. Otherwise lounges or a quiet gate corner are cheaper.
tom: I'll bring extra stickers as bribes for lounge passes :grimacing: Thanks all, very helpful. Safe travels!
